dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular ovoid 'O' structures with high-contrast dark perimeters transitioning to light interiors are concentrated along the dorsal midline. A prominent central annulus displays a closed geometric boundary, while an adjacent posterior structure forms an open 'C' shape.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of high-intensity pixels lacking internal gradients are observed with highest density in the anterior cervical region and lower density as discrete speckles interspersed between macro-annuli along the lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli form an elongated triangular pattern along the longitudinal axis, with internal angles approximately 120, 30, and 30 degrees.
